notes: Posted 2 December 2001 as a revised version of the Light Side deck Reinhold played at the 2001 Decipher World Championship (FreedomCon), where he reached the top 8; the description gives '10-1 in tourny play, only loss to Bastian in game 8 at worlds'. The format is Premiere - Reflections III.

Starting cards as posted: An Unusual Amount Of Fear, We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates, Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core, Naboo: Theed Palace Generator, Inner Strength, Podrace Prep, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Anakin's Podracer and Boonta Eve Podrace; these count toward the 60.

The starting section ends with a bare '[effect]' placeholder (an unnamed effect slot); it names no card and is not counted. Without it the list totals 60, matching the section counts (effects 7, epic events 1, characters 12, weapons & devices 2, ships 2, interrupts 27). 'LS Got Shield?' is a heading, not a card.

The author's update 3 defines the 'new' cards as the Reflections III printings: 'New Quiggy' dested Qui-Gon Jinn, Jedi Master; 'New Yoda' dested Yoda, Master Of The Force; 'New Lando' dested Lando Calrissian, Scoundrel; 'New quiggys stick' dested Qui-Gon's Lightsaber (Reflections III).

Posted 'Generator Core' and 'Generator' dested the Light Reflections III sites Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core and Naboo: Theed Palace Generator (the objective's starting sites); 'Jedi Luke' dested Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'luke's lightsaber' dested Luke's Lightsaber (Death Star II); 'Caldera Ringham' dested Caldera Righim.

Posted 'honor' dested Honor Of The Jedi; 'OTE' dested Order To Engage; 'Eject Eject' dested Eject! Eject!; 'I did it' dested I Did It!; 'han/chewie/falcon' dested Han, Chewie, And The Falcon; 'step backwards' dested A Step Backward; 'its a trap' dested It's A Trap!; 'anakin's racer' dested Anakin's Podracer.
Posted 'Out Of Commision Combo', 'Sense/Recoil In Fear' and 'free ride/endor celebration' dested as the combo Interrupts.
Shields: 'DDTA' dested Don't Do That Again; 'only jedi have that weapon' dested Only Jedi Carry That Weapon; 'ou nee ta' dested Ounee Ta.
player_note: The post calls this a revised version of the deck that took him to the top 8; the exact Day 2 list was posted elsewhere.
